name: Jev Compute
description: The prompts JevAgent's mid-run compute checkpoint uses when it acts on a situation Jev recognized. reset_prompt is the task given to a fresh helper agent when the main agent keeps retrying an approach that already failed: it carries the user's request, the stuck problem, the approaches already tried, and the open errors, and asks the helper to find the cause, fix it without repeating those approaches, and report. Its placeholders are {request}, {problem}, {attempts}, and {failures}. reset_result is the message the main agent then reads, carrying the helper's report; its placeholders are {problem} and {report}.
